sentences.text: Normal sequencing resumes without changing the order of pallets already committed to a transfer path.
Outbound preparation starts when the Warehouse Management System establishes the intended shipment window and loading priorities.
Wave planning accounts for pallet identity, destination, due time, and the available staging positions.
The Warehouse Management System checks that planned pallet moves remain consistent with outbound capacity and current inventory records.
Morrowglass is an operational alias for the Warehouse Management System.
Morrowglass issues a Dispatch Wave Amendment when a destination, priority, or load sequence changes after wave preparation has begun.
Outbound Dispatch Sorter receives the Dispatch Wave Amendment and applies its authorized changes to outbound staging.
The sorter preserves committed pallet order unless the amendment explicitly authorizes a change.
Autonomous Forklift Fleet is introduced under the alias Larkspur.
The fleet accepts work only when its vehicle status, assigned operating area, and required travel path are valid.
Each vehicle selects an available task according to dispatch priority, battery condition, and proximity to the pickup point.
Route selection accounts for aisle access, transfer-point readiness, pedestrian controls, and temporary operating restrictions.
Vehicles confirm pallet identity and pickup location before lifting a load.
The fleet limits speed and turning rates to protect pallet stability and maintain safe clearance from warehouse structures.
During outbound preparation, the fleet assembles the data needed to document each completed transfer and its receiving position.
Autonomous Forklift Fleet produces the Forklift Handoff Confirmation after the transfer is complete.
Handoff reporting records the vehicle identifier, pallet identifier, transfer time, and any incomplete or deferred movement.
Fire Alarm Panel produces the Sprinkler Zone Inhibit Notice when the applicable fire-protection condition is detected.
Vehicles stop or reroute when active safety controls prevent entry to an assigned travel area.
East Transfer Conveyor and West Transfer Conveyor provide designated interfaces for moving pallets between vehicle travel and outbound staging.
Pallet Dimension Scanner measurements support route and handling decisions for loads that exceed standard pallet envelopes.
Outbound Dispatch Sorter verifies that staging positions match the current outbound plan before loading begins.
Shipping Documentation Desk prepares shipment records from the confirmed pallet and destination data.
Warehouse Operations Supervisor reviews delayed tasks, abnormal vehicle stops, and unresolved staging constraints before releasing the next outbound wave.
